questions.question: Orient verdicts are in the trace: BK-423 and BK-414/BK-420 constrain the rewrite (they get named in the RFC), while BK-384, BK-397 and BK-366 are unrelated. Two lines outside the RFC go stale the moment it merges: BK-418's backlog body says "Four interventions are unmeasured", and report.md § Run B baseline says the route choice is "settled when RFC-0020 is rewritten; until then the RFC's rule is the one in force". What scope should this PR have?

options.label: RFC + two stale lines (Recommended)
options.description: Rewrite RFC-0020, plus the trace and both decision logs. Also correct BK-418's body to "rule (c) is unmeasured, run B tests it", and turn the report's 'until then' sentence into a pointer to the RFC's decision rule. That keeps the repo matching reality at this commit (principle 3), costs about four lines, and grows no process file.

options.label: RFC text only, as framed
options.description: Only the RFC, the trace and the logs. The backlog body and the report sentence stay stale until a later PR, and run B's session reads them as written.

options.label: RFC + backlog line only
options.description: Fix BK-418's body, but leave report.md alone, since the research record is a dated record. The report's 'until then' sentence then points at a rule that no longer exists.
